title: bacterial-wgs-nf: Nextflow pipeline for quality control, species verification, assembly, annotation, antimicrobial resistance, core-genome SNP and pangenome analysis of bacterial isolate genomes
description: Species-agnostic Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for Illumina paired-end bacterial isolate whole-genome sequencing: PhiX removal (BWA-MEM, SAMtools), read trimming (Trim Galore/Cutadapt by default, or fastp), species identification and purity check (Kraken2, Bracken) with a QC gate, de novo assembly (SKESA) with an assembly QC gate, ANI to a reference (FastANI), annotation (Prokka), antimicrobial resistance genes (RGI/CARD), core-genome SNP alignment (Snippy), pangenome (Roary), assembly metrics (QUAST) and MultiQC reporting. Capsule and outer-core/O-antigen locus typing (Kaptive 3) runs automatically for Acinetobacter baumannii and the Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex, the only species with Kaptive databases.
